author: Nick Carter (mrnicholasbcarter-code); code merged in PR 1057

acceptance.criterion: verdict autodev --dry-run --json on the operator setup plans with a planner chosen by the live ladder, and no HTTP 402 occurs

first_run.command:
rm -rf /tmp/autodev-dry && git init -q /tmp/autodev-dry && printf 'def add(a, b):
    return a + b
' > /tmp/autodev-dry/calc.py && git -C /tmp/autodev-dry add calc.py && git -C /tmp/autodev-dry commit -q -m init && .venv/bin/python -m verdict autodev --objective "Add a one-line docstring to the add function in calc.py" --repo /tmp/autodev-dry --dry-run --json 2>/tmp/autodev-dry.err | jq -c '{planner_model: .model, units: (.units | length), usage}'; RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf '{"http_402_in_stderr": %s}
' "$(grep -c -E ' 402 ' /tmp/autodev-dry.err)"; exit $RC

stays_true_job: NO SCHEDULED JOB re-runs autodev --dry-run (DoD part 4 gap); verdict-acceptance.timer re-runs the shared selection ladder hourly through its eligibility and choose checks

setup_doctor.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'
